signature: “Gord H f J För Kong. Cappel [royal chapel orchestra] et Stockholm G. Ahlgren 1776” [check initials]; 3 crowns [repoussé], 3 sheafs of wheat [repoussé; Ahlgren’s master’s mark?].
remarks: Slide stuck—can be pulled out  approx. 25mm; ext. measurement of inner slide tubes = 11.3; 2 tubular slides stays, lower one telescopic; repair at immoveable slide stay, top; slide bow has bow guard, but no saddle or ring; ferrules have typical Ahlgren star pattern; one tubular bell stay, flattening out on bellpipe side, with eye, hinge, and pin; ring and saddle in bell bow. Examined by the author, August 2002.
